create_DensePoseDataRelative_from_annota: create a DensePoseDataRelative instance from an annotation dict containing normalized xy coordinates and optional IUV or vertex data
validate_DensePoseDataRelative_annotatio: validate a DensePose annotation dict to check it has required xy keys and either IUV or CSE setting keys
extract_segmentation_mask_from_annotatio: extract a 256x256 segmentation mask tensor from an annotation dict using pycocotools mask decoding
apply_transform_to_DensePoseDataRelative: apply horizontal flip and rotation transforms to DensePoseDataRelative point coordinates and segmentation masks
move_DensePoseDataRelative_to_device: move a DensePoseDataRelative instance and all its tensor attributes to a specified torch device like cuda
